rules.name: iron-fly-1115
rules.what: Every day at 11:15: sell the at-the-money call and put of the nearest expiry, and buy a call 1% above and a put 1% below the stock price as a safety net; close all four at the close. Wins when the stock stays calm; the worst possible loss is fixed when it opens (about $400-550). No proven edge: running to test the live system with a capped loss.

rules.name: put-spread-monthly
rules.what: Once a month, on the first trading day after the monthly options expire (3rd Friday), at the close: sell the put about 5% below the stock and buy the put about 10% below, both expiring next month, and hold them to expiry. Wins when the stock doesn't fall more than ~5% in the month; the worst loss is the gap between the strikes minus the credit. Backtest 2013-2026: +$42/trade, 91% won, t 2.2 (short of the 2.6 needed): tested unchanged on new months (HYPOTHESES.md, H4).
